content_sections.heading: How Will RITES Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written Test Document Scrutiny Written test will consist of 125 objective type questions carrying one mark each for a duration of 2.5 Hours with no negative marking. PwBD candidates get 50 minutes of extra (compensatory) time in the written test. Document scrutiny will be done initially in the ratio of 1:3 of the vacancies notified.

content_sections.heading: RITES Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: A minimum of 50% marks for UR/EWS (45% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts) in the written test is required. Written test centres: Delhi/Gurugram, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Guwahati and Bhubaneswar. All centres except Delhi/Gurugram are provisional and depend on the number of candidates. Candidates give two centre choices in the online application; the exact address will be informed later.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 December 2026. Applications opened on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 3 Technical Assistant (Draughtsman / Bridges & Railway alignment), 4 Technician-I (Draughtsman/ Bridges & Railway alignment), 1 Technician-I (Draughtsman/ Stations).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General/OBC Candidates: Rs. 300 plus Taxes. EWS/ SC/ST/ PWD Candidates: Rs. 100 plus Taxes.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Technical Assistant (Draughtsman / Bridges & Railway alignment): maximum 36 years; Technician-I (Draughtsman/ Bridges & Railway alignment): maximum 33 years; Technician-I (Draughtsman/ Stations): maximum 33 years. Relaxation: SC/ST 5, OBC-NCL 3, PwBD 10, Jammu & Kashmir domicile 5; RITES regular/contract employees 5.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: INR 24,000-90,000 for Technical Assistant (Draughtsman / Bridges & Railway alignment), INR 22,000-83,000 for Technician-I (Draughtsman/ Bridges & Railway alignment), INR 22,000-83,000 for Technician-I (Draughtsman/ Stations).

faq.answer: Matriculation plus ITI in relevant trade or Diploma in Civil/Architecture. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.
